definition: Seconds from the nearest EIA Weekly Natural Gas Storage Report, Thursday 10:30 New York time, negative before it and positive after.
boundaries: New York time follows its daylight-saving rule. Holiday moves are not modelled. It is a fixed clock, not the report's numbers. Bars without a time are missing. QML's unit runtime passes each bar its close time, so inside a unit this value reads from the first bar. As a lone slot binding it holds nothing: bind value-above to it to gate on the seconds.
recognition: Gas units go flat before the Thursday storage report.

sources.quote: Weekly Natural Gas Storage Report Thursday at 10:30 a.m.

golden.reference: local event times from zoneinfo (the IANA tz database), in qml/tests/golden/beyond-fx/reference_run.py
